thag2.35:1.1: Devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati ekako cāhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi: tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato n' atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā. || ||
thag2.35:2.1: dhammatā mam' esā yassa me ekakassa bherave bile viharato n' atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā 'ti. || || Sambulakaccāno thero.
